notes.title: Slimebrawl is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
Fellow brawlers,

Welcome to Slimebrawl!

Slimebrawl is now live across all regions for purchase on Steam.

We would like to thank you for your interest in our first title on Steam, and we hope that you will enjoy it!


Now, the future of the game.


DEVELOPER ROADMAP:

Now that the game is out, this is in no way an end to the development of the game. Here we can shortly summarize our current plans for the foreseeable future. Hope you will support us in our journey for this release, and many more.

First of all, regarding online multiplayer. This feature wasn't planned from the beginning, however we are currently working on an online connectivity solution which will be patched into the game within a few weeks. Until then, you can play the game in Local Multiplayer as it was first envisioned.

In the meantime, we are also working on patching in a new map, as well as new weapons, customization options and UI updates. These smaller patches and content add-ins are independent from the announced big patch which should bring online multiplayer to the game, and will arrive as soon as they are done.

Lastly, we are planning on adding steam cards to the game, and we are looking foward to implementing them.

Any other big changes to the game will be announced on Steam so you can look forward to them.


At last, if you encounter any bugs, please contact us on the discussion forum by posting in the open bug topic. We will look into any problems you might encounter, locate them, and push updates to fix them.
